title: Stray 's' in config deprecation warning also disables textwrap.dedent(), leaving the message indented
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

In `ConfigOption.set_value()`, the deprecation warning for a not-yet-expired config option opens its f-string with a stray `s` character:

```python
# lib/streamlit/config_option.py:285
get_logger(__name__).warning(
    textwrap.dedent(
        f"""s
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════
        {self.key} IS DEPRECATED.
```

This has two effects. The obvious one is a literal `s` printed at the start of the warning. The subtler one is that `textwrap.dedent()` silently stops working: `dedent` strips the longest common leading whitespace across all non-blank lines, and `s` is a line with **zero** indentation, so the common prefix becomes `""` and nothing is stripped. Every subsequent line keeps its 20 spaces of source indentation.

The sibling "expired" branch a few lines above is written correctly and dedents as intended, which makes the difference easy to see side by side.

### Reproducible Code Example

```python
import logging

from streamlit.config_option import ConfigOption

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s|%(message)s")

opt = ConfigOption(
    "test.notexpired",
    description="d",
    default_val="",
    deprecated=True,
    deprecation_text="Use something else.",
    expiration_date="2999-01-01",
)
opt.set_value("x", "some_file.toml")
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Run the snippet above (any deprecated config option whose `expiration_date` is in the future takes this branch).
2. Compare the output with the expired branch (set `expiration_date="2020-01-01"`).

### Expected Behavior

The warning should be flush-left and free of stray characters, matching the expired-option message:

```
════════════════════════════════════════════════
test.notexpired IS DEPRECATED.
Use something else.

This option will be removed on or after 2999-01-01.

Please update some_file.toml.
════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

### Current Behavior

```
WARNING streamlit.config_option: s
                    ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    test.notexpired IS DEPRECATED.
                    Use something else.

                    This option will be removed on or after 2999-01-01.

                    Please update some_file.toml.
                    ════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

For contrast, the expired branch on the same run is correct:

```
ERROR streamlit.config_option:
════════════════════════════════════════════════
test.expired IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED.

Use something else.

Please update some_file.toml.
════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

### Suggested Fix

Delete the stray `s` so the first line is empty and `dedent()` can compute the correct common prefix.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The deprecation warning contains no leading `s`.
- [ ] The warning body is dedented, matching the formatting of the expired-option error.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

Unknown.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.62.0 (`develop`, commit `2ac0d77d3`)
- Python version: 3.13.6
- Operating System: Windows 11 (platform-independent)
- Browser: n/a

### Additional Information

This branch is currently hard to hit in practice because the only deprecated option in `config.py` (`mapbox.token`) is already past its expiration date and therefore takes the *other* branch — see the companion issue about that expiry. Any newly added deprecation would surface this immediately.

comments.body:
Confirmed bug in `ConfigOption.set_value()` (`lib/streamlit/config_option.py`). The not-yet-expired deprecation warning opens as `f"""s` instead of `f"""`. That leftover `s` is a conversion leftover from PR #10133 (commit `7a7ddbb`), which rewrote `%(key)s` percent-format placeholders into f-strings and accidentally kept the `%s` conversion character. Because `s` is an unindented first line, `textwrap.dedent()` finds no common leading whitespace and leaves the rest of the banner indented. The expired-option branch immediately above is written correctly. Existing tests (`test_deprecated_unexpired`) call `set_value()` but never assert the warning text, so this slipped through. Impact is currently low: the only deprecated option (`mapbox.token`) is already expired and takes the other branch. Fix is to delete the stray `s` and assert the warning message (no leading `s`, flush-left like the expired error).

### Related Issues

- [#16678](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/16678) — Companion report on the same `ConfigOption` deprecation path: `mapbox.token` is past its `expiration_date`, so users currently see the expired **ERROR** instead of this warning. Extending that date would immediately expose this formatting bug.
- [#12743](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/12743) (closed) — Separate `feature:config` bug where deprecation warnings were still shown because `client.showErrorDetails` did not parse string values. Same warning surface, different cause.

No duplicate of the stray-`s` / `dedent()` failure was found.
